dilated aorta, fluttering of anterior MV leaflet
: surgery is mainstay of TX, optimize medical management of comorbidities (HF TX)
: obstruction of flow into LV ⇣ EDV
» Progresses over years from asymptomatic to SXS of profound HF
: dyspnea, fatigue, dysphagia (esophageal compression by enlarged LA),
: hoarseness caused by enlarged LA compressing
low-pitched rumbling diastolic murmur at apex
normal opening at start of diastole), loud S1

pulmonary HTN (tetralogy of Fallot, VSD) MCC
: asymptomatic; RHF SXS when regurgitation results in RVH & decompensation (DOE MC)
high-pitched early diastolic decrescendo murmur at LUSB
: directed at cause of PR, annual f/u for H&P & TTE
: DOE, peripheral edema, RUQ pain (hepatic congestion)
mid-diastolic rumbling murmur at LLSB w/ opening snap
: RAE, tall/peaked T waves in inferior leads/V1
: dilated SVC, RAE (enlarge R heart border)
: low sodium diet, diuretics, aldosterone antagonists
